items.name: theme
items.title: Béton theme
items.description: Design tokens: palette, semantic colours, type scale, radii, hard shadows and motion.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

theme.font-sans: "Public Sans", "Public Sans Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
theme.font-mono: "JetBrains Mono", "JetBrains Mono Variable", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

items.docs: Load Archivo, Public Sans and JetBrains Mono, for example with next/font or Fontsource.

items.name: core
items.title: Béton core
items.description: Class merging, shared interaction styles and the render prop helper.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Sections of content that open one at a time, or several at once.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A message that stays on the page: a warning, a result, a piece of context.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Interrupts to confirm a consequential action. The choice has to be explicit.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A profile image that falls back to initials when the image is missing or fails.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: back-to-top
items.title: Back to Top
items.description: A button that returns to the top of a long page, and moves focus there too.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A short status or category label in a monospace sticker.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: The trail of pages above the one you are on.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Triggers an action. Presses down by exactly its shadow offset.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month of dates, one of which can be chosen.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A bordered container with a hard shadow, composed from header, body and footer parts.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A square toggle for independent choices, with an indeterminate state.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: A block of code with a copy button and a scrolling region you can reach.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: A searchable list of commands in a dialog, opened with a keyboard shortcut.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: confetti
items.title: Confetti
items.description: A burst of hard paper squares when something goes right.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A menu opened by right-clicking an area, with the same items as a dropdown menu.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: counter
items.title: Counter
items.description: A number that counts up in hard steps and lands on its value.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: cursor-trail
items.title: Cursor Trail
items.description: Hard squares that follow the pointer.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: description-list
items.title: Description List
items.description: Pairs of terms and their values: metadata, receipts, specifications.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal window for focused tasks, with trapped focus and a clear way out.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A menu of actions opened from a button, with checkboxes, radios and submenus.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: What to show where there is nothing yet: no results, no records, no files.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Label, control, description and error message, wired together with validation.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: fieldset
items.title: Fieldset
items.description: Groups related controls under a shared legend.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.description: A drop zone backed by a native file input, with a removable file list.

items.name: form
items.title: Form

items.name: glitch-text
items.title: Glitch Text
items.description: Text with two coloured copies jittering behind it.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: grid-background
items.title: Grid Background
items.description: Graph paper behind a section, drawn rather than downloaded.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: halftone-background
items.title: Halftone Background
items.description: A field of printed dots, as though the section came off a press.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A preview panel shown when a link is hovered or focused.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line text field with a thick stroke and hard shadow.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Displays a keyboard key or shortcut.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Names a form control, with optional required marker.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: list
items.title: List
items.description: A vertical list of records: a mark, a title, a line of detail and row actions.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: Content that slides past, forever, and pauses when you point at it.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A row of menus along the top of an application, as in a desktop app.

items.name: navbar
items.title: Navbar

items.name: noise-overlay
items.title: Noise Overlay

items.title: Number Input

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input

items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Move through a list that is split across pages.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A non-modal panel anchored to its trigger, for secondary detail and small forms.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group

items.name: scramble-text
items.title: Scramble Text

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area

items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: search-input
items.title: Search Input
items.description: A search field with an icon and a clear button.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A custom listbox for choosing from a set of options.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A solid ink rule in three stroke weights, horizontal or vertical.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel anchored to an edge of the screen. A dialog, parked at the side.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton

items.name: slider

items.title: Spinner

items.name: split-flap

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat

items.name: stepper

items.name: sticker
items.title: Sticker

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch

items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Rows and columns of data, with sortable headers and row actions.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs

items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: text
items.title: Text & Heading

items.name: textarea

items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Brief messages that stack in the corner and never steal focus.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short visual label shown on hover and keyboard focus.
items.author: Nabaskar Brahma (https://github.com/nabrahma)

items.name: typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.description: Words typed out one character at a time, with a blinking block.
